usageGuideIntro: Save frequently used content in SiYuan documents, then search, preview, insert, or copy it.
usageGuideAdd: Add: click “＋ New item”, or save a selection, current block, clipboard text, or context-menu target. You can also use the command palette or editor context menu to discover existing content from the current document.
usageGuideSearch: Find: search titles, aliases, summaries, tags, and categories; try pinyin, Favorites, Recent, or Frequent sort.
usageGuideInsert: Use: Enter inserts, Ctrl/⌘ + Enter copies; Alt/⌥ + 1-9 inserts directly, Alt/⌥ + Shift + 1-9 copies; Tab moves between search and actions; long-press a row for more actions.
usageGuideInsertMobile: Use: tap a row to select it, then use the primary footer button. Without a specified target, this copies; with a target, follow the button label. Long-press for more actions. Direct insertion into the active mobile editor is unverified in the real client.
sidecarReadOnly: Sidecar data could not be read or comes from a newer plugin version. Saving is blocked to preserve the original data. Use a compatible version or restore access and reload; current settings will not persist.
exportIncompleteIndex: Export canceled: the library index is incomplete. Rebuild the index and retry.
exportItemReadFailed: Export canceled: could not read item “%s”: %s
exportBodyMissing: Export canceled: item “%s” has no body in the export. Please retry.
exportTooLarge: Export canceled: the template pack exceeds %s characters. Export categories separately.
usageGuideOrganize: Organize: use clear titles, tags, and categories; Settings → Data & Templates includes invoicing, return guidelines, email, address, and contact examples.
usageGuideVariables: Templates & comments: {{xlc:ask:field}} prompts before insert, with options support; placeholders expand only on use. Code items remain literal and do not expand variables. Aliases serve as usage notes, and blockquotes (> 💡 Note) work as inline guidelines. AI is off by default.
mediaContentHint: Images and attachments show Markdown source; Copy copies link text. Use Open source to view the original file. Bitmap and file copying are not supported.
usageGuideMedia: Images & attachments: add the image, PPT, PDF, or resume file to SiYuan first, then save it from the image or resource-link context menu. The panel shows Markdown source and copies link text; use Open source to view the original file. Bitmap and file copying are not supported; there is no built-in PPT reader.
usageGuideMultiblock: Unresolved: multi-paragraph Markdown or mixed structures may be split into multiple SiYuan blocks while only the first is registered. Preview, copy, edit, or export can be incomplete. Avoid saving a full resume or company introduction as one item for now; check existing content in the library document.
multiBlockPendingHint: Multi-block integrity is unresolved: Markdown or mixed structures may register only their first block and produce incomplete output. Avoid saving multiple paragraphs for now; verify existing items in the library document.
